resources.string: Track your nights. Every number explained.
Tap Going to bed when you turn in, and I\'m up when you get up. Those two taps define your night.
This night started on %1$s, %2$s ago. Did you forget to tap I\'m up?
Sound levels only. No audio is recorded or stored.
The microphone is hearing complete silence. Check that microphone access isn\'t switched off in quick settings, and that no other app is using the mic.
SleepTight needs the microphone to measure how loud your room is. It only keeps sound levels, never audio. Your taps still record the night either way.
The microphone couldn\'t be used. Another app may be using it, such as a call or a voice recorder.
Android stopped SleepTight in the background. Allow it to run without battery restrictions so this doesn\'t happen overnight.
Notifications are off, so there\'s no tracking notification. Tracking still works.
Android can stop apps in the background while you sleep. Let SleepTight run without battery restrictions so it keeps measuring until you get up.

On Samsung phones, also open the app\'s settings, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted. Make sure SleepTight isn\'t listed under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps (Settings → Battery → Background usage limits).
Shown while SleepTight is measuring sound levels overnight
Tells you if overnight tracking stopped
Measuring sound levels only. No audio is recorded.
SleepTight stopped measuring sound levels. Open the app to resume.
Wakes you in this window when you seem to be stirring, or at %1$s at the latest.
No alarm. Turn it on before you tap Going to bed.
Snoozes are counted towards your goal of at most one, but never blocked.
Your alarm volume is off, so the alarm will only vibrate. Turn up the alarm volume in your phone\'s sound settings.
SleepTight isn\'t allowed to set exact alarms, so the alarm can\'t ring on time. Allow \"Alarms & reminders\" for SleepTight.
SleepTight can\'t show the alarm over your lock screen. It will still ring, but you\'ll need to unlock to stop it. Allow full-screen notifications for SleepTight.
Notifications are off, so the alarm can\'t show its screen or Snooze and Dismiss buttons. It will ring for up to 10 minutes; open SleepTight to stop it.
That time hasn\'t happened yet. Pick an earlier wake time.
Your phone\'s clock is earlier than your bed tap, so the night can\'t be closed. Check the date and time settings.
